name: A Barricade of Blades
text: Contents: Shadows in the Night, Dark Protégé, and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Ninja Swarm). Setup: Put each The Streets Below environment into play. Set the Dark Protégé encounter set aside. Choose 1 random villain from that set and reveal its side A, then shuffle each card linked to that villain into the encounter deck.

name: A Barricade of Blades
text: In expert mode, the villain gets +1 SCH and +3[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would be defeated on side A, instead flip it to side B, reset its hit points, and change the villain's position. Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card. If the villain is defeated on side B, the players win the game.

name: Fortress Lockdown
text: While the forces on the outside hold the heroes back, ninjas on the inside lock every door and window. In expert mode, the villain gets +3[per_hero] hit points. When Revealed: Change the villain's position. Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a minion and reveals it. (Shuffle.)

name: Fortress Lockdown
text: In expert mode, the villain gets +1 SCH and +3[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would be defeated on side A, instead flip it to side B, reset its hit points, and change the villain's position. Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card. If the villain is defeated on side B, the players win the game. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

name: The Streets Below
text: VILLAIN POSITION. If both positions are the same: • Each character gets +1 ATK. If the positions are different: • Reduce the amount of damage each character takes from each attack by 1. • Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme.

name: Atop the Tenshu

name: The Streets Below
text: HERO POSITION. First Player Action: Resolve one of the effects below, then flip this card: • Place 3 threat on the main scheme and stun your identity. • Spend [physical] [physical] resources. • Spend 1 resource of any type and exhaust an AERIAL character you control.

name: Atop the Tenshu
text: HERO POSITION. First Player Action: Resolve one of the effects below, then flip this card: • Deal 3 damage to your identity. • Spend [energy] [energy] resources. • Discard an ally or upgrade you control.

name: * Black Tarantula
text: Guard. When Revealed: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, Black Tarantula attacks you; otherwise, give the villain and Black Tarantula each a tough status card.

name: * Ghost Maker
text: When Defeated: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, discard 1 card you control; otherwise, take 2 indirect damage. [star] Boost: If an ally is defending against this attack, reveal this minion.

name: Sealed Entrances
text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) When Defeated: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase.

name: Strategic Positioning
text: Under Shadowland, the Hand rules the streets. While the villain's position is The Streets Below, this scheme gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]). While the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, this scheme gains 1 hazard icon ([hazard]).

name: Surround the Fortress
text: When Revealed: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, place 1[per_hero] threat on the main scheme; otherwise, place 1[per_hero] threat here.

name: Chaos in Hell's Kitchen
text: When Revealed: Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, place 2 threat on the main scheme; otherwise, take 2 damage. [star] Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

name: Moonlit Silhouette
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Change the villain's position if it has not changed this phase. You are confused. When Revealed (Hero): If the villain's position is Atop the Tenshu, the villain schemes; otherwise, the villain attacks you.
